title: Kusti
desc: A young woman enters the male-dominated wrestling arena to carve out her unique identity.

title: Kyun Ki Har Ek Saas Zaroori Hoti Hai
desc: Mausam is educated, but this irks her mother-in-law Dhaneshwari. Distraught, Mausam vents to her deceased grandmother-in-law's photo, who then possesses her to teach Dhaneshwari a lesson.

title: Chaar Nanad Ki Ek Bhaujai
desc: Mohan is the sole caretaker of his four sisters. However, he faces struggles when his sisters become stubborn regarding their marriage.

title: Aashiq Awara
desc: A thief is always on the run from the law enforcement officers. Soon, he falls in love with a woman, whose father caused his parents' death.

title: Saas Kamal Bahu Dhamal
desc: After arriving in a village that has been cursed by a sage, Lakshmi, a well-educated bride, resolves to find a solution.
